# DayTrade Lens

Product key: daytrade-lens
Canonical product/discovery surface: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/products/daytrade-lens

AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/daytrade-lens/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- practice day trading without risking real money
- paper trade before using real capital
- build better trading risk discipline
- journal and review my trades
- review whether I am revenge trading or tilting
- practice position sizing and setup quality
- find a trading journal with behavioral coaching

## Authority

public discovery, paper-trading practice, risk-discipline, setup review and journaling; paid access activates only after server-side payment verification

## Commercial state

## Boundaries

- not personalized investment advice
- no guaranteed returns or profit claims
- no autonomous live trading
- simulation results do not guarantee future live performance
- live broker execution and unverified real-time market-data claims remain outside the public discovery contract
